packageRules.description: The Dockerfile ARGs pin each base image by digest

customManagers.description: The upstream zfs_exporter release. Renovate can move the version, but it cannot move the per-architecture digests in checksums.txt. Run hack/update-upstream.sh to rewrite those digests. Without that step the build fails on a checksum mismatch, and it installs nothing unreviewed

The kubeconform version pinned in the CI workflow. The workflow builds the download URL from this variable, so the match must read the assignment and not the URL. Renovate cannot move the sha256 next to it; move the digest by hand from the CHECKSUMS asset of the release
